A farm that wants 122 keys hence pays 122 sequential derivations, which cannot be parallelised without buying proportionally more hardware. Key derivation for an identity is deliberately slow at 269 seconds of sequential work, so minting one key is inexpensive once and expensive in bulk. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
